entities.note: rows 1-6: four hollow 6x6 squares, left to right colour 9 (cols 18-23), 14 (25-30), 11 (32-37), 15 (39-44), on a grey(5) backing strip rows 0-7 cols 17-45; they are the required OUTPUT sequence: a run fills them one by one (a filled square becomes solid)
grey strip rows 0-7, cols 17-45 behind the four target squares

hollow colour-8 rectangle rows 25-34, cols 18-45 with black(0) corner brackets = the PROGRAM (main frame) holding 4 slots at cols 20-23, 26-29, 32-35, 38-41 (rows 27-30); its contents are read left to right on RUN
2x2 red(2) dots at rows 29-30, cols 22-23 / 28-29 / 34-35 / 40-41 = the empty slots; clicking one with a block selected moves the block there; a dot reappears wherever a block leaves

solid 4x4 blocks in the inventory row 57-60: 14 at cols 18-21, 15 at 26-29, 9 at 34-37, 11 at 42-45 (same colours as the targets, different order); a clicked block gets a 1-px BLACK(0) outline = selected
row 53: colour 2 from the left = remaining energy (64 px = 64), colour 3 eats in from the right 1 px per move/swap click and per RUN; select/deselect/undo/misclick are free

rules.note: click a block (its 4x4 interior): it gets a black outline = selected; clicking the selected block again deselects; clicking another INVENTORY block moves the selection; free
with a block selected, clicking a red dot moves the block onto that slot (the dot vanishes there and a dot appears in the block's old place); selection cleared; costs 1 energy
with a block selected, clicking a block that is inside the frame (or clicking an inventory block while the selected one is in the frame) swaps the two positions; costs 1 energy
a click on the frame border, the target squares, the bars or empty ground does nothing and is free

RUN (costs 1 energy): a black 6x6 cursor walks the slots left to right while an 8x8 cursor walks the target squares; a block whose colour equals the current target FILLS that square (solid) and both advance; a colour mismatch, an empty red dot or running out of slots before the last square is filled = FAIL: cursors flash colour 8, all fills are cleared, blocks stay where they are
UNDO: blocks and red dots return to their positions before the last energy-costing click; free, energy not refunded

goal.note: the four slots of the frame must read, left to right, exactly the target colours 9, 14, 11, 15 and then ACTION5 must be pressed; the level ends when the last target square fills; minimum 9 actions (4 x select+place, then RUN)
